image_plane_geometry.coverage_assessment: IMAGE_PLANE_MATHEMATICALLY_NON_DEGENERATE; central floor coverage is broad, but near markers are close to the lower image boundary and full-workspace robustness is not yet validated.

required_human_measurements: Confirm that marker IDs 1, 2, 3, and 4 are fixed floor workspace-reference markers and will not move during this geometry session.
Define the world origin physically and define the +X and +Y floor directions.
Measure the black encoded-square side length for IDs 1, 2, 3, and 4, or confirm they share one measured side length.
Provide the world-frame center coordinate (X, Y) for each of IDs 1, 2, 3, and 4.
Provide the in-plane yaw of each marker relative to +X, or confirm a shared alignment and identify which marker edge follows +X.
measurements_not_required_if_above_are_p: Pairwise marker distances are not additionally required because they are derivable from the measured world centers.
Robot marker ID 0 size and pose are not required for the floor Homography bootstrap.
